# Google Flights Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/google-flights-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/google-flights-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects flight data from Google Flights, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Google Flights Data in 2026](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-google-flights)
- **Code:** [`google_flights.py`](google_flights.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Oneway](results/oneway.json) · [Price insights](results/price_insights.json) · [Roundtrip](results/roundtrip.json)

## What it scrapes

- Google Flights search results (round-trip and one-way)
- Price insights: best booking window, typical price range, current price level, savings vs typical, and a departure/return date price calendar grid

## Functions

- `scrape_flights(origin, destination, depart, ret=None, currency='USD')` → `FlightSearch`: Scrape Google Flights results for a route and date(s).
- `scrape_price_insights(origin, destination, depart, ret=None, currency='USD')` → `Optional[PriceInsights]`: Scrape the Price insights panel for a Google Flights route.

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`AirportInfo`**: `name?`, `id?`, `time?`
- **`FlightLeg`**: `departure_airport?`, `arrival_airport?`, `duration?`, `airplane?`, `airline?`, `airline_logo?`, `travel_class?`, `flight_number?`, `legroom?`, `extensions`
- **`Layover`**: `airport`, `duration?`
- **`FlightResult`**: `airline?`, `flight_number?`, `departure_time?`, `departure_airport?`, `arrival_time?`, `arrival_airport?`, `duration?`, `stops`, `layovers`, `price?`, `currency`, `cabin_class?`, `plane_model?`, `extensions`, `legroom?`
- **`FlightSearch`**: `search_date`, `route`, `departure_date`, `return_date?`, `flights`
- **`CalendarPriceEntry`**: `depart`, `ret`, `price`
- **`PriceInsights`**: `best_booking_window?`, `current_price_level?`, `typical_range_low?`, `typical_range_high?`, `savings_vs_typical?`, `calendar_grid`

A field marked `?` can be `null`.

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`google_flights.py`](google_flights.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)
- `render_js` = `True`: render the page in a real browser

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/google-flights-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_scrape_flights`, `test_scrape_price_insights`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
